calculationModal.title: Driving performance
calculationModal.question: How are premium adjustments calculated?
calculationModal.performanceDescription: This is an average of your trip scores in the last 12 months.
calculationModal.scoresDescription: Your rating for each trip is measured in a score from 0 to 5, with 5 being the best. The overall score and your eligibility will determine whether your premium adjustment changes at the end of each assessment period.
calculationModal.disclaimer: Both current and projected premium adjustments are estimates, as your final premium is determined by a collection of factors.
calculationModal.tripPerformanceDescription: Your trip performance is calculated by analyzing information about your speed, smoothness of handling, duration of your trips and distractions while driving. Your ratings for each trip are reflected in this section.

factors.speedDesc: Your driving speed relative to the posted speed limit.
factors.brakingDesc: Moments when you braked suddenly or roughly.
factors.corneringDesc: Quick change of direction while traveling at speed.
factors.durationDesc: Journeys of over 90 minutes begin to be graded for duration.
factors.distractionsDesc: Phone use detected while driving, including from phone speaker, handling of the phone, or hands-free use.

calculationModal.nightDrivingDescription: Night-time driving events between 11 PM and 5 AM will affect your score differently than driving events during the day.
